label: v8 verify-loop vs the same 30 tasks V5/V7-c scored 10/30 on
why: Paired comparison on the exact 30 task ids of the V7-c/V5 screen, same order, so the only difference is the archive. V8 keeps V5's budget envelope byte for byte (150 s / 45 calls / 80 turns / 5.25 min, same sampling, same tools) and changes one lever: the last edit must be run, and a failure must be corrected. Our own traces: sessions whose last action was an unrun edit resolved 0 of 6 tasks; sessions that ran something after the edit resolved 10 of 20.
